payload.title: enforcement-scope-stated states what stance-guard-precise has not yet built
payload.body: Assaying enforcement-scope-stated of plan guard-precision at 75257332: the README now says every guard's judge is handed only the test in a few sentences and the act and contract. That holds for the purview guard, but not for the stance guards, which still send the whole 14 KB stance rubric; cutting that rubric looks like the work of stance-guard-precise, which is still active. enforcement-scope-stated depends on purview-guard-precise, pre-call-refusal-holds and omp-guard-precise, but not on stance-guard-precise, so the statement can land before the behaviour it describes. The verdict is not-achieved on that clause alone. How the unit reaches achieved (waiting for stance-guard-precise, or a dependency on it) is the planner's to decide.
